title: Clarify cleanup timing and ownership for landed and staged-tree worktrees
outcome: Clarify cleanup timing and ownership for landed and staged-tree worktrees
acceptance: Clarify that cleanup of a landed candidate worktree waits until the item has closed and required evidence is no longer needed.
Clarify who owns cleanup for staged-tree landings and other non-candidate worktrees while keeping AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md byte-identical.
